description: This file is a server-side module for a SvelteKit application handling cases (support tickets or similar entities). It includes load functions that fetch and transform case data from a Django REST API, as well as actions for creating, updating, closing, reopening, deleting cases, and managing comments and case movement. It serves as the backend logic layer for a 'Cases' page, integrating multiple API calls and data transformations.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches case data, related entities, and dropdown options from API; transforms data into frontend structure; handles filtering, pagination, and view modes.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new case via API with data obtained from form submission.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing case based on form data via API.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Sets case status to 'Closed' via API.

methods.name: reopen
methods.description: Reopens a case by setting status to 'Assigned' via API.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Adds a comment to a case via API.

methods.name: moveCase
methods.description: Moves a case within a Kanban board or list, updating position and status via API.
